Name: Katsuki Bakugo from My Hero Academia NPC Mod
Author: emkabonbonka
Description:
This is the initial release of my Katsuki Bakugo NPC mod.

Katsuki currently lives and works at the Blacksmith. He can be befriended, dated, married, and appears at several festivals. He has custom dialogue, heart events, gift tastes, dating dialogue, marriage dialogue, and festival dialogue.

This is my first release, so there may still be bugs or missing polish. Please let me know if you find any issues. If anyone is good at making spouse rooms, lmk :').

Art by Juneisal
